name: Argentina
hint: a huge country of grassy pampas and icy Patagonia, east of the Andes
facts: Aconcagua, in Argentina, is the highest mountain in the Americas.

asks: Which country has Aconcagua, the highest mountain in the Americas?

name: Bolivia
hint: a landlocked country high in the Andes, in the middle of South America
facts: Salar de Uyuni in Bolivia is the largest salt flat in the world.

asks: Which country has Salar de Uyuni, the largest salt flat in the world?

name: Brazil
hint: the giant country on South America's Atlantic side, crossed by the Amazon River
facts: Brazil is the largest country in South America, covering nearly half the continent.
Brazil is the only country in the Americas with Portuguese as its official language.
hint2: This country's capital is a planned city that opened in 1960, far from the coast.

name: Chile
hint: a long, thin country between the Andes and the Pacific Ocean
facts: Chile is more than 4,000 km long, but on average less than 200 km wide.

name: Colombia
hint: the country at South America's north-west corner, where the continent meets Central America
facts: Colombia is the only South American country with coasts on both the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea.

name: Ecuador
hint: a small Andean country on the Pacific coast, between Colombia and Peru
facts: Ecuador's name is the Spanish word for the equator, which runs across the country.

name: Guyana
hint: a rainforest country on South America's north coast, between Venezuela and Suriname
facts: English is the official language of Guyana.

name: Paraguay
hint: a landlocked country in the heart of South America, between Argentina, Bolivia and Brazil
facts: Paraguay's flag shows a different emblem on each side.

asks: Which South American country's flag shows a different emblem on each side?

name: Peru
hint: an Andean country on the Pacific coast, between Ecuador and Chile
facts: Machu Picchu is a stone city built by the Inca, high in the Andes of Peru.

name: Suriname
hint: a small rainforest country on South America's north coast, just east of Guyana
facts: Suriname is the smallest country in South America, by both land and people.

name: Uruguay
hint: a small, grassy country on the Atlantic coast, between Argentina and Brazil
facts: Uruguay hosted and won the first soccer World Cup in 1930.

name: Venezuela
hint: a country on the Caribbean coast of South America, between Colombia and Guyana
facts: Angel Falls in Venezuela, 979 m high, is usually counted as the world's tallest waterfall.
